metadata.name: asana__daily_metrics
metadata.comment: Table of task metrics per each day

date_day.comment: Unique day for which metrics are calculated.

number_of_tasks_open.name: number_of_tasks_open
number_of_tasks_open.comment: The number of tasks open at that point in time

number_of_tasks_open_assigned.name: number_of_tasks_open_assigned
number_of_tasks_open_assigned.comment: The number of tasks that are open on that day and have been assigned

number_of_tasks_created.name: number_of_tasks_created
number_of_tasks_created.comment: The number of tasks created on that day

number_of_tasks_completed.name: number_of_tasks_completed
number_of_tasks_completed.comment: The number of tasks completed on that day

avg_days_open.name: avg_days_open
avg_days_open.comment: The average time that all tasks open on this day have spent open.

avg_days_open_assigned.name: avg_days_open_assigned

metadata.name: asana__project
metadata.comment: Table of projects' basic info enriched with metrics regarding tasks and completions

project_id.name: project_id
project_id.comment: System-generated unique ID of the project.

number_of_open_tasks.name: number_of_open_tasks
number_of_open_tasks.comment: Count of the currently open tasks in this project

number_of_assigned_open_tasks.name: number_of_assigned_open_tasks
number_of_assigned_open_tasks.comment: Count of the open and assigned tasks in this project.

number_of_tasks_completed.name: number_of_tasks_completed
number_of_tasks_completed.comment: Count of tasks that have been completed in this project

avg_close_time_days.name: avg_close_time_days
avg_close_time_days.comment: The avg number of days it has taken to close tasks in this project

avg_close_time_assigned_days.name: avg_close_time_assigned_days
avg_close_time_assigned_days.comment: The avg number of days it has taken to close tasks, since their *last* assignment, in this project

project_link.name: project_link
project_link.comment: URL formatted to bring you directly to the project in asana.

team_id.name: team_id
team_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_TEAM that the project is associated with

team_name.name: team_name
team_name.comment: User-facing name of the project's team

is_archived.name: is_archived
is_archived.comment: Boolean representing if the project has been archived in the UI

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the project was created

current_status.name: current_status
current_status.comment: The most recent progress status update for the project (free-form string)

due_date.name: due_date
due_date.comment: The date the project is due on, if given

last_modified_at.name: last_modified_at
last_modified_at.comment: Timestamp of when the project was last modified (doesn't include comments or tasks)

owner_user_id.name: owner_user_id
owner_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who owns the project.

users_involved.name: users_involved
users_involved.comment: Aggregated list of the names + roles of the users involved (working on or owning) a project

number_of_users_involved.name: number_of_users_involved
number_of_users_involved.comment: Count of the unique users associated with the project

sections.name: sections
sections.comment: Aggregated list of the sections that exist in the project.

notes.name: notes
notes.comment: Free-form textual description associated with project

is_public.name: is_public
is_public.comment: Boolean that's true if public to the whole workspace, false if private.

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

metadata.name: asana__tag

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the tag was created

number_of_open_tasks.name: number_of_open_tasks
number_of_open_tasks.comment: Count of the currently open tasks with this tag.

number_of_assigned_open_tasks.name: number_of_assigned_open_tasks
number_of_assigned_open_tasks.comment: Count of the open and assigned tasks with this tag.

number_of_tasks_completed.name: number_of_tasks_completed
number_of_tasks_completed.comment: Count of tasks with this tag that have been completed.

avg_days_open.name: avg_days_open
avg_days_open.comment: The avg number of days that completed tasks with this tag were open.

avg_days_assigned.name: avg_days_assigned
avg_days_assigned.comment: The avg number of days that completed tasks with this tag were open and assigned.

metadata.name: asana__task
metadata.comment: An enriched task table consisting of base task info + aggregated metrics and lists

task_id.name: task_id
task_id.comment: System generated unique ID of the task.

assignee_user_id.name: assignee_user_id
assignee_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_USER that is currently assigned the task.

is_completed.name: is_completed
is_completed.comment: Boolean that is true if the task is currently marked complete.

completed_at.name: completed_at
completed_at.comment: Timestamp of when the task was marked complete.

completed_by_user_id.name: completed_by_user_id
completed_by_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the USER who completed the task. Note that this may be different than the assignee

created_at.name: created_at
created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the task was created

due_date.name: due_date
due_date.comment: Date the task is due, if provided.

modified_at.name: modified_at
modified_at.comment: Timestamp of when the task was last modified

parent_task_id.name: parent_task_id
parent_task_id.comment: Self-referential id of the parent TASK that this is a subtask of.

start_date.name: start_date
start_date.comment: The start date of the task, if a date range is given.

task_description.name: task_description
task_description.comment: Free-form text describing the task, as seen in the UI.

is_liked.name: is_liked
is_liked.comment: Boolean that is true if the task is liked by the authorized user.

number_of_likes.name: number_of_likes
number_of_likes.comment: Number of users who have liked this task.

workspace_id.name: workspace_id
workspace_id.comment: Foreign key reference to the workspace

task_link.name: task_link
task_link.comment: URL formatted to bring you directly to the task in asana.

assignee_name.name: assignee_name
assignee_name.comment: Name of the user that the task is currently assigned to.

assignee_email.name: assignee_email
assignee_email.comment: Email of the user that the task is currently assigned to.

days_open.name: days_open
days_open.comment: The number of days the task has been/was open (creation -> completion)

is_currently_assigned.name: is_currently_assigned
is_currently_assigned.comment: Boolean, true if the task is *currently* assigned

has_been_assigned.name: has_been_assigned
has_been_assigned.comment: Boolean, true if the task has at one point been assigned, even if currently not.

days_since_last_assignment.name: days_since_last_assignment
days_since_last_assignment.comment: The number of days the task has been/was open and assigned to to the most recent user (last assignment -> completion)

days_since_first_assignment.name: days_since_first_assignment
days_since_first_assignment.comment: The number of days the task has been/was open and assigned at all (first time assigned -> completion)

last_assigned_at.name: last_assigned_at
last_assigned_at.comment: Timestamp of when the task was last assigned (to the current user if still assigned)

first_modifier_user_id.name: first_modifier_user_id
first_modifier_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_USER who made the first modification to the task (ie added a description). A proxy for task creator.

first_modifier_name.name: first_modifier_name
first_modifier_name.comment: Name of the user who made the first modification to the task

conversation.name: conversation
conversation.comment: The task's comments and authors aggregated into an ordered conversation, with authors + time sent

number_of_comments.name: number_of_comments
number_of_comments.comment: Count of comments made on the task

followers.name: followers
followers.comment: A list of the names of the users who follow the task.

number_of_followers.name: number_of_followers
number_of_followers.comment: Count of the users following the task

tags.name: tags
tags.comment: A list of the tags associated with the task.

number_of_tags.name: number_of_tags
number_of_tags.comment: Count of the tags associated with the task.

project_ids.name: project_ids
project_ids.comment: List of all `project_ids` associated with the task.  You can parse or explode the items in the list using a comma + space (`", "`) as a delimiter. To keep the table grain at the task_id level, this list is not parsed by default.

project_names.name: project_names
project_names.comment: List of all `project_names` associated with the task.  You can parse or explode the items in the list using a comma + space (`", "`) as a delimiter. To keep the table grain at the task_id level, this list is not parsed by default.

projects_sections.name: projects_sections
projects_sections.comment: A list of the projects + sections that this task is listed under. You can parse or explode the items in the list using a comma + space (`", "`) as a delimiter. To keep the table grain at the task_id level, this list is not parsed by default.

number_of_projects.name: number_of_projects
number_of_projects.comment: The number of projects associated with the task.

is_subtask.name: is_subtask
is_subtask.comment: Boolean that's true if the task is a subtask of another.

parent_task_name.name: parent_task_name
parent_task_name.comment: User-facing name of the task's parent task.

parent_assignee_user_id.name: parent_assignee_user_id
parent_assignee_user_id.comment: Foreign key referencing the ASANA_USER who is assigned the parent task

parent_assignee_name.name: parent_assignee_name
parent_assignee_name.comment: Name of the user assigned this task's parent task

parent_due_date.name: parent_due_date
parent_due_date.comment: Date on which the parent task is due, if given

parent_created_at.name: parent_created_at
parent_created_at.comment: Timestamp of when the parent task was created

has_stats.label: Has Stats?
has_stats.description: Indicates whether there are statistics for this table

avg_close_time_assigned_days.name: avg_close_time_assigned_days
avg_close_time_assigned_days.comment: The avg number of days it has taken projects of this team to close tasks, once assigned

active_projects.name: active_projects
